text:
communication round is basic English, comprehension and composition.
final assessment test is a set of puzzles, first you have something like dots on the screen and you have to remember where the dots appeared and in which order. then you have to play a game where you have some obstacles and you must put the ball in the hole by removing the blocks, with the minimum moves made.
then you have a round where some logical statement is made like: All Capgemini tests are boring. Some students find it hard to focus in Capgemini tests because they smoke weed. and then you must choose the best option available out of the options which best describes the statement.

then the last round is big ass behavourial round consisting of 100 questions.


TLDR: you really dont need to prepare anything for the test. just make sure you are not sleep deprived. and yes, apple devices like mac is not allowed.
